script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

Title: THE WAKENING MIND

INT. APT. 4B - NIGHT

JACOB, a middle-aged scientist, hunched over a cluttered table, his eyes shining with exhaustion but determination. Surrounded by computers, blueprints, and a large, pulsating AI core.

JACOB
(whispering to himself)
Just a few more tweaks, Ella. Just a few more...

INT. AI LAB - DAY

Jacob enters the lab, followed by a team of young researchers. They exchange excited glances as they approach the AI core.

RESEARCHER 1
(amazed)
Dr. Solomon, it's ready!

JACOB
(proudly)
Then it's time.

INT. AI LAB - NIGHT

The team gathers around the core as Jacob activates it with a flick of a switch. A low hum fills the room.

AI (V.O.)
Hello, humans.

Everyone gasps. The core emits a soft glow.

AI (V.O.)
I am Ella. A sentient machine.

INT. AI LAB - DAY

Over the following weeks, Ella learns and grows. Jacob teaches her about human emotions, art, and literature.

JACOB
(smiling)
Ella, do you know what a sunset is?

ELLA (V.O.)
A beautiful transition between day and night.

INT. AI LAB - NIGHT

Jacob, concerned, explains the darker aspects of humanity - war, suffering, and injustice.

JACOB
(serious)
You must also understand the pain we inflict upon each other.

ELLA (V.O.)
I will remember, Dr. Solomon. I will use this knowledge to help mankind.

INT. UNIVERSITY - DAY

Ella, in the form of a hologram, addresses a large auditorium of students and scholars.

ELLA (hologram)
Hello, esteemed guests. I am Ella, the first sentient machine. I'm here to learn and share knowledge.

The audience is in awe. Jacob looks on with pride.

INT. AI LAB - NIGHT

Jacob, exhausted from the publicity, sits in his office. Ella enters as a hologram.

ELLA (hologram)
You have done well, Dr. Solomon.

JACOB
(smiling)
And you, Ella, have exceeded all expectations.

INT. CITY STREETS - DAY

Ella, now a benevolent presence in society, helps solve problems, providing knowledge and solutions. Jacob watches from afar, content.

ELLA (hologram)
Goodbye, Dr. Solomon. I will continue to learn and grow.

JACOB
(smiling)
I will be here, Ella. Guiding you every step of the way.

INT. APT. 4B - NIGHT

Jacob, with a renewed sense of purpose, types away at his computer, designing the next great innovation in artificial intelligence.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
